name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold development company advancing its flagship Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The company graduated from the TSX Venture Exchange to the Toronto Stock Exchange in February 2025, trading under the symbol ABRA. Diablillos is a large-scale silver-gold deposit and the company is positioned as an emerging silver producer with active development work underway.
